subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw accept A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge, and should that wait for the canonical browser Canvas action-ingress work?
rationale: The request spans product direction and a trust boundary: sandboxed/browser-origin UI would ask a trusted parent to route actions into Gateway-controlled behavior, and the required dashboard and Canvas ingress substrates are not settled on main.

options.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and the dashboard widget host first, then implement the bridge against the approved action contract.

options.title: Sponsor Dashboard-First Bridge
options.body: Allow a dashboard-owned bridge to proceed before the generic Canvas action endpoint, accepting the risk of defining the first web A2UI action contract there.

options.title: Move Outward After API Seams
options.body: If this should not be bundled dashboard work, defer it to an external plugin or ClawHub package once the needed plugin APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and the dashboard widget host first, then implement the bridge against the approved action contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main Canvas/plugin-tab ownership signal and is already associated with the adjacent bundled tab precedent.
